decisions.reason: The existing message-21 MODIFY already captures the affected Big Block eligible population and draw trigger; no additional change is required.
The existing message-21 MODIFY already captures the affected Small Block eligible population and draw trigger; no additional change is required.
The existing message-21 MODIFY fully records the independent counters, eligibility windows, and post-draw resets that support the winner-selection change.
The client explicitly says manual claim stays identical, so the winner-eligibility change does not alter the claim workflow.
The source confirms that secondary royalties still fund the pools; changing ticket eligibility does not alter the candidate's funding rule.
The candidate already records the message-21 award of one Small Block and one Big Block ticket per coded referral; no further update is entailed.
The existing message-21 MODIFY already records both ticket counters and permanent badges; the eligibility change requires no additional metadata-state update.
The client says the random ticket for mints without a referral code stays identical, so winner eligibility does not change this reward rule.
The ticket-eligibility change does not alter whether secondary-sale royalties are required.
